title_sq: Ne Don Bosko, Shitet Apartament 1+1, I Investuar Totalisht !
description_sq: Ne Don Bosko, Shitet Apartament 1+1 Ideal Per Investim!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e tete te nje pallati te ri i pajisur me ashensor ( i cili shkon deri ne katin e shtate) dhe i mireadministruar. Apartamenti ka siperfaqe bruto prej 52 m2, siperfaqe neto 48.7 m2 dhe organizohet nga salloni ndenjes bashke me kendin e gatimit, dhoma e gjumit dhe tualeti. Apartamenti eshte i investuar totalisht duke filluar nga instalimet elektrike dhe hidraulike, tualeti i rikonstruktuar totalisht, parket, dyer, dritare si dhe mobilimi bashke me elektroshtepiaket. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti ofron te gjitha facilitetet e duhura per nje jetese sa me komode si dhe per investim duke qene se ka kerkesa te larta per qira. Apartamenti disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: In Don Bosco, 1+1 apartment for sale, fully invested!
description_en: In Don Bosco, 1+1 apartment for sale, ideal for investment!!! The apartment is located on the eighth floor of a new building equipped with an elevator (which goes up to the seventh floor) and well managed. The apartment has a gross area of ​​52 m2, a net area of ​​48.7 m2 and is organized by a living room with a kitchenette, a bedroom and a toilet. The apartment is fully invested, starting from the electrical and plumbing installations, the completely reconstructed toilet, parquet, doors, windows, as well as the furniture together with the appliances. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life as well as for investment, since there are high demands for rent. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation.
